name: White Box Fix
teaser: Solves the issue of a white square appearing in the inventory when quickly dragging items, thereby preventing loss of control
description_html:
I think many have one way or another seen this white square that appears in the middle of the screen and blocks control

I don’t know how it is now, since this patch is always with me :), but about a year ago it often interfered with the game.

After writing this plugin, I have never encountered it, the plugin has no conflicts and is compatible with versions at least from 3.5.6 to 3.8.1.

I think it will not require updating in the future

Solves the issue of a white square appearing in the inventory when quickly dragging items, thereby preventing loss of control
